record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. Draft 6 proposes a centre and sandbox for model evaluation and certification before adoption; the AI strategy remains a proposal.

check.language_note: The recorded pt queries use a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. The earlier English-search pass on 17 October 2026 left the then-recorded national or official-language coverage unchanged; the work is described below. Search batches for the additional status review, using 1-based positions in check.searches: 3, 6; 4, 5. Each group records the same exact registered URLs found in its combined search results, without attribution to an individual query. Explicit page opens and finds and unverified URL variants are excluded. Groups list the recorded queries; some requests also contained additional queries retained in the research evidence.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: The full CNIA decree confirms advisory governance. Draft 6 proposes a model-evaluation centre for assurance before adoption, without specifying the qualifying model class and capability or behaviour-risk function. A more specific technical remit could change this finding. The 14 October 2026 official account still calls the strategy a proposal.

next_check.reason: Check adoption of the strategy and whether the testing centre receives duties to evaluate the safety of advanced models; inspect future CNIA recommendations.

related_bodies.name: Centro Nacional de Testes, Avaliação e Auditoria de IA / Sandbox Regulatório Nacional de IA (draft P6.I5)
related_bodies.role: It is a proposed testing, model evaluation, certification and audit centre combined with a regulatory sandbox. Draft 6 covers imported, open, proprietary, adapted and domestic models and testing before public or institutional adoption. INTIC, the CNIA executive secretariat and sectoral regulators are assigned implementation. The stated remit is assurance before adoption; the text does not specify the qualifying model class and capability or behaviour-risk function.

related_bodies.name: Comissão Nacional de Inteligência Artificial (CNIA)
related_bodies.role: It advises on AI policies, research institutions and adoption. It is a consultative and technical advisory body subordinate to the Council of Ministers. Decree 14/2026 created it, taking effect on publication on 17 April 2026. The retrieved decree does not assign a unit to evaluate advanced models.

record.notes: Draft 6 was retrieved again and read beyond P6.I5. P6.P11 covers imported, open, proprietary, adapted and domestic models. The governance table gives the sandbox testing and audit duties for robustness, safety, bias, performance, privacy and high-risk systems. This is a substantive model-evaluation proposal framed as assurance before adoption. The retrieved text does not specify an ongoing evaluation remit for general-purpose, foundation or frontier models for their capabilities or behaviour risks. A more specific technical remit could change the assessment. The full CNIA decree was retrieved: it establishes a consultative and technical advisory body subordinate to the Council of Ministers, with powers to advise on research institutions and AI adoption. This supersedes the earlier access limit, not the historical review record. No qualifying commission recommendation was found. INTIC still described the AI strategy as a proposal on 14 October 2026. English and Portuguese searches found no later act resolving the centre remit or adopting the strategy.

closest_body.name: Centro Nacional de Testes, Avaliação e Auditoria de IA / Sandbox Regulatório Nacional de IA
closest_body.note: Draft 6, linked from the public consultation, proposes a centre and sandbox for model evaluation and certification before public or institutional adoption. It covers imported and domestic models. The retrieved text does not establish a qualifying model class and capability or behaviour-risk remit, and adoption remains unverified.

claims.text: The draft national AI strategy lists the "National Artificial Intelligence Regulatory Sandbox: technical unit responsible for testing, evaluation, validation, auditing and regulatory learning for AI systems".
The draft national AI strategy assigns the national testing centre and regulatory sandbox supervised testing, model evaluation and certification before public or institutional adoption.
The draft national AI strategy assigns the national regulatory sandbox supervised testing and regulatory learning before public or institutional adoption.
